name: NVIDIA GB10
reference: Memory: 246 GB/s GPU streaming read from cudaMalloc, measured by tools/gb10/memory_probe.cu on an idle GB10 (CUDA 13.0.88, driver 580.173.02, 2026-09-27); NVIDIA's DGX Spark specification is 273 GB/s LPDDR5X. Compute is derived, not a datasheet dense figure: NVFP4 dense is half of NVIDIA's 1 PFLOP sparse FP4 rating; BF16 dense is NVFP4/4, the ratio of the RTX PRO 6000 profile; FP32 is the commonly reported 31 TFLOPS. Replace with NVIDIA dense rates when published.
